findings.finding: Under otherwise current synthetic test bindings, the JS projection accepts empty keys plus empty independent answers, nonexistent key IDs plus matching review IDs, duplicate independent IDs, and a whitespace-only reviewerId. The Python linked-question check likewise lacks valid-option membership and duplicate validation. The canonical bank validator normally rejects such malformed records, but the separate fail-closed resource gate must not convert them into projected approvals.
findings.requiredRepair: Require nonempty unique literal key and independent answer arrays containing only the question’s valid stable option IDs; require a nonblank independent reviewer identity; never substitute conditional intended IDs. Align JS/Python checks and test the rejected cases.

findings.finding: The resource gates reject only unreviewed/unresolved dispositions, so an unknown disposition passes. A consistently mutated physicalPage0 also passes JS eligibility. The algorithm selector already uses a positive bounded physical-page check and an explicit disposition allowlist, but the projection/numerical gates do not.
findings.requiredRepair: Require one-based integer physicalPage within source.pageCount and an explicit supported disposition, with complete source/hash/sourceId/inspection consistency. Apply the same requirements to linked question citations as well as resource sourceRefs, in both language layers.
